name: Lily
source:
"Gimme a reward for working really hard♪"

Likes: Mint, Master
Dislikes: Boredom
Hobbies: Teasing Mint
Special Ability: Misdirection

A half-animal, half-demon girl.

She has animal-like ears and a tail, as well as black wings.

She has the demonic power to make people unaware of her presence (she very easily blends in with her surroundings).

Possessing a great body, she uses that to tease Mint. Wanting to help pay her way while living with you and Mint, she hides her true identity in order to take on a part-time job. 

She likes to have fun and joke around, but deep down is a serious girl who is always willing to give her honest opinion and offer advice on anything. 

Voice Profile: Somewhat mature but not a particularly low voice. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789650/NEKOMIMI_SWEET_HOUSEMATES_Vol_1]Steam[/url]]
